def update_tool(
    db: orm.Session, tool: models.DatabaseTool, updated_tool: models.CreateTool
) -> models.DatabaseTool:
    tool.name = updated_tool.name
    tool.integrations = updated_tool.integrations
    tool.config = updated_tool.config
    db.commit()
    return tool
